in_marathi.name: Sapna
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sapna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sapna', meaning 'dream' or 'vision'. In Hindu mythology, 'Sapna' is believed to be the goddess of dreams, who appears in our dreams to guide us and reveal our inner desires and aspirations. She is also associated with the night sky, the moon, and the stars.
